compatibility.part: S8 MaxV Ultra vs. S8 Max Ultra and S8 Pro Ultra
compatibility.detail: These are separate robots. The S8 MaxV Ultra manual identifies U.S. model S82USV. Its dedicated washable robot filter is Roborock part RR-LW0-S8MaxVUltra-P02, and its Max-series main-brush pack differs from the S8 Pro Ultra pack. Do not choose a part from an 'S8' title alone.

Roborock lists washable filter part RR-LW0-S8MaxVUltra-P02 for S8 MaxV Ultra and S8 Max Ultra. Search by this part number and verify the exact S8 MaxV Ultra fit before ordering; a generic S8 or S8 Pro Ultra listing alone does not confirm compatibility.

The S8 MaxV Ultra uses both a screw-mounted Edgewise mop cloth and a separate VibraRise cloth. The mixed Amazon pack linked above includes both styles, but they attach to different mounts and are not interchangeable.

The linked Amazon parent listing has multiple bag variations. The S8 MaxV Ultra-compatible product detail is under '1-Dust Bag'; the separate '2-Dust Bag' variation is for other models, including S8 Pro Ultra. Verify the selected option and dock bag collar at checkout.

The two main rollers underneath the robot collect floor debris. The small high-speed brush in the RockDock Ultra cleans the mop-washing module. These are separate parts and have separate replacement intervals.

The water filter in the dock is separate from the washable air filter in the robot dustbin. Roborock says to rinse the dock water filter as needed and does not give it a scheduled replacement interval.

care.replace: No scheduled replacement interval in the manual

careTip: Rinse the washable robot-bin filter with clean water and let it dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling it. Clean both main rollers every two weeks, clear hair from the flexible side brush monthly, and wash either mop cloth whenever dirty. Keep the separate dock water filter and high-speed maintenance brush clear of debris.

questions.question: Which replacement filter fits the Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra?
questions.answer: Roborock lists washable filter part RR-LW0-S8MaxVUltra-P02 for S8 MaxV Ultra and S8 Max Ultra. Search by this part number and verify the exact S8 MaxV Ultra fit before ordering; a generic S8 or S8 Pro Ultra listing alone does not confirm compatibility.

questions.question: Are S8 MaxV Ultra and S8 Pro Ultra replacement parts interchangeable?
questions.answer: Not in general. Roborock specifies a dedicated filter and main-brush pack for the S8 MaxV Ultra/S8 Max Ultra family. Only buy a shared item, such as the dock-cleaning brush or side brushes, when the product's compatibility evidence names the exact model.

questions.question: Which Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra dust-bag option should I choose?
questions.answer: Choose the Amazon variation labeled '1-Dust Bag'; its product details name S8 MaxV Ultra and describe a six-pack of 2.7 L bags. The parent listing's '2-Dust Bag' variation is for different models, including S8 Pro Ultra. Check the dock collar before ordering.

questions.question: Does the S8 MaxV Ultra use one kind of mop pad?
questions.answer: No. It has a screw-mounted Edgewise mop cloth and a separate VibraRise cloth. The third-party twelve-piece listing shown here says it includes six of each style; compare each pad with its own mount before use.

questions.question: How often should I replace S8 MaxV Ultra filters, brushes and mop cloths?
questions.answer: Roborock recommends replacing the washable robot filter and main brushes every 6–12 months, the flexible side brush every 3–6 months, both mop cloths every 3–6 months, and the dock high-speed maintenance brush every 6–12 months. Clean the filter and main brushes every two weeks, the side brush monthly, and the dock brush as needed. Replace damaged parts sooner.
